description: Implementation of the WiFi Access Point WPS API, including singleton management of device instances, with functions to get and close instances, and placeholder getter methods for WPS enable status and configuration methods.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_WPS
classes.description: Class managing WiFi Access Point WPS configurations and instances, including singleton pattern implementation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_WPS for a given device ID, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Returns list of all current hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_WPS instances.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Removes and deletes a specific hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_WPS instance.

methods.name: closeAllInstances
methods.description: Closes and deletes all hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_WPS instances.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_WPS_Enable
methods.description: Placeholder method to get WPS enable status.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_WPS_ConfigMethodsSupported
methods.description: Placeholder method to get supported WPS configuration methods.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_WPS_ConfigMethodsEnabled
methods.description: Placeholder method to get enabled WPS configuration methods.
